messages:
Mia C.: ok team, kicking off a focused 2-week sprint to launch the community code-labs + a lightweight refapp. goal: reusable tutorial pack, 1 launch post, and a live webinar to drive signups :rocket:
Sam P.: love it. timeline? webinar date?
Mia C.: target webinar = Tue May 17 10am PT. launch post + tutorial set must be published 3 days before for SEO and preregistration flow.
Jonah R.: can we bake the benchmark narrative into the tutorial? short bench section showing latency/cost tradeoffs vs common open checkpoints. 3 charts max. :bar_chart:
Lee (DevRel): yep — I'll produce a small harness that runs 5 queries, measures p95 latency and cost-per-1k-tokens. will be runnable with `make bench` in the repo.
Nat G.: PR/marketing asks: a short hero stat, 2–3 screenshots, and a one-minute demo gif. we'll also need a clear CTA for the refapp: "Try the refapp" + email capture.
Sam P.: inbound lead routing: we should tag HubSpot leads with `source:code-labs` and `campaign:community-launch-may17`. DevRelBot can create the webhook mapping if we give the field list.
Mia C.: action items: 1) Jonah + Lee: bench harness + example results (due Tue May 3) 2) Lee: repo + `make bench` and a tiny README (due Fri Apr 29) 3) Nat: landing copy + hero assets (first draft Mon May 1) 4) Sam: HS routing + webinar registration flow + automated drip (start Mon Apr 29)
Jonah R.: ack. bench design: 5 prompts (conversational + QA + long-context summarize). will include both local quantized run and hosted Redwood API run for parity.
Lee (DevRel): sample webhook payload for HubSpot leads (we'll map `campaign`, `source`, `utm_medium`):
```
POST /hubspot-webhook
{
  "email": "user@example.com",
  "campaign": "community-launch-may17",
  "source": "code-labs",
  "product_interest": "refapp"
}
```
Sam P.: perfect. for routing we'll set up a pipeline rule: if `campaign == community-launch-may17` then assign to `growth-inbound` queue and add tag `refapp-oss`. also add `lead_score += 5` for webinar registrants.
Nat G.: assets checklist: 1) hero screenshot 2) 1-min demo gif 3) 3-step install snippet 4) bench chart images 5) copy for tweet thread and GH release notes. I'll mock tweet thread tomorrow.
Mia C.: messaging iteration note — avoid heavy "cost savings" claims. lead with "consistently low latency at scale" and show numbers. we'll include a short FAQ block about privacy / private deployments.
Jonah R.: quick note on bench reproducibility: include exact model revision and tokenization snippet. example in README:
```
MODEL=redwood-1b 
python bench.py --prompts prompts.yaml --runs 3
```
Lee (DevRel): DevRelBot: please create the repository `community/code-labs-refapp` and add a `bench` GH action that runs on push to main. :robot_face:
DevRelBot: created repo community/code-labs-refapp and added initial bench workflow. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/community/code-labs-refapp
Sam P.: webinar ops: Zoom + Hopin fallback, registration page on our site with UTM tracking. follow-up: automated email + invite to a private Slack channel for early adopters.
Mia C.: last check — who will write the launch post? Jonah + Nat collaborate on tech narrative, Mia will edit for voice and SEO. Nat will draft social copy and short webinar description.
Jonah R.: will start draft tonight.
Mia C.: great. next sync Fri Apr 26 9am PT to review assets. please add blockers to the doc and ping here if anything slips. :eyes:
